enchantments.tooltip: Wisdom +5: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +5 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Intimidate +11: Passive: +11 Competence bonus to the Intimidate skill.
Incite +56: +56% Enhancement bonus to increased threat generation from melee damage
Insightful Command: Passive: +4 Insight bonus on Charisma based skill checks. Command armor and command shields make their owners very noticeable, imposing a -6 penalty on Hide checks.
Mroranon's Might: 2 Pieces Equipped:+1 Artifact bonus to Strength+5 Artifact bonus to Melee and Ranged Power
Immunity to Fear: The wearer of this item is immune to all fear effects.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
